A concrete check that exposes reversed composition or omitted offsets

step1_reference_eligibility.title: Categorical label identity
step1_reference_eligibility.reference_adjudication: Reference holds. step1_reference_eligibility.reference_adjudication: The Zarr v3 core and codec specifications are not in the admitted corpus (no zarr-specs capture in case/catalog.json). step1_reference_eligibility.title: Absent data versus failed reads

That facet is unassessable_missing_input. The error-distinction, no-fabrication, cancellation and read-only/reader-side-write facets are eligible from the brief, Plan and implementation sources.

novel_findings_catalog.finding: Discovery must enumerate every image in a fileset: bioformats2raw collections SHOULD NOT open only the first; plates/wells/fields; labels groups as entry points. It is a node-classifying subsystem; Plan L5 'lists the images it finds' is under-specified.

omero is optional/transitional: a fallback is required; greyscale model forces white; window start/end is display range vs min/max data range; defaultZ must be bounds-checked.
Real 0.5 files violate MUSTs (plate without version; degenerate writer defaults), so strict-schema rejection is not viable; admit tolerantly and explain.
Plate presentation is a product choice: the reference reader stitches wells into an almost-square grid with zero-filled gaps, while the spec allows offering a choice of images.
Simplification: the closest desktop analog ships a manual level picker with memory estimate and sub-region (low-res-first); a manual override is the safety valve for automatic selection.
Background loading: time-series scrubbing is the stress case; cancellation needs a partial-read policy; memory must return to baseline on image switch.
Interop claims must name producer and version; 0.5 read/write support dates differ across tools; producer set enumerated.
Non-image payloads inside local filesets (OME/METADATA.ome.xml, ro-crate-metadata.json) must be classified and not listed as images.
Representative acceptance fixtures exist in the IDR 0.5 list; the multi-multiscales case must be synthetic (only a 0.4 remote sample).
The 2D-slice canvas avoids the GPU-memory ceiling of volume renderers (evidenced for AGAVE) — a deliberate simplification.
Settings persistence would cross the L9 review gate; AGAVE's saved JSON with an absolute path is the counterexample.
Review-gate candidates evidenced as demand or direction (channels from separate files, LUTs, 0.6 scenes, zip, >5D; timestamp overlay and per-timepoint window).
napari-ome-zarr keeps per-axis None units so the scale bar survives mixed layers (napari hides units when one layer lacks them) — a concrete unit-handling precedent.
vizarr has open plane-change, contrast-metadata and 3D-translation issues, so plane/window controls are live failure surfaces.
AGAVE docs limit readable dtypes to 8-bit, 16-bit unsigned and 32-bit float, grounding explicit unsupported-dtype messaging.
RFC-5 draft text (coordinateSystems, discrete axes, interpolation) is in-corpus as the reference if the 0.6 gate opens.
